rationale: For an Indian equity swing trader's nightly review workflow, a dark-mode, high-density terminal approach is ideal. It strips away decorative SaaS elements (like soft shadows and purple gradients) in favor of stark contrast, functional color coding, and razor-sharp data legibility.

rules: CRITICAL: All financial figures, tickers, and tabular data MUST use JetBrains Mono to ensure vertical alignment.
Headings should use tight letter spacing.
Never center-align tabular data; right-align numbers, left-align text.
Color is Function Only: 95% of the UI is monochrome.
Use #A855F7 ONLY for the 'purple dot' tag as a solid, flat background or text color—ABSOLUTELY NO purple gradients.
Hover states must explicitly set text color to ensure contrast (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white).

spacing_and_layout.grid_mode: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
rules: Use sharp edges (rounded-none). The interface should feel like a piece of precision machinery.
Expose the skeleton: Use 1px solid borders (border-zinc-800) heavily to separate grid items and tabular data.
No soft drop shadows. Use 1px borders and distinct surface colors to create depth.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.panels: Solid flat backgrounds (#121212) with a 1px border (#27272A).
surfaces_and_micro_themes.active_states: Use 'Retro-Futurism' subtle touches for active items—a 1px bright accent border (e.g., border-emerald-500) rather than a background fill.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.tables: border-collapse style with subtle bottom borders (border-zinc-900) for rows. Hover states should highlight the entire row (bg-zinc-800/50).

components_strategy.regime_hero_panel: A stark, high-contrast dashboard header. Instead of large cards, use a dense grid of 4 pillars (Trend, Momentum, Breadth, Volatility) showing clear Pass/Fail tags and monospace values.
components_strategy.primary_secondary_candidates: High-density data tables utilizing Shadcn Table primitives. Use Shadcn Badges with sharp corners for Grades (A+ to G).
components_strategy.positions_tracker: State machine UI using explicit colored tags for status (PENDING_CONFIRM, ACTIVE, EXITED). Include progress bars (built with standard div tags) to show distance to stop or extension.
components_strategy.rs_grid: A dense heatmap-style grid or table showing the Nifty 500, filtered by Grade. Use a distinct solid purple square icon or tag for 'purple-dot'.
components_strategy.pipeline_control: A utilitarian action area. The trigger button should be sharp, rectangular, with an ASCII or simple monospace progress indicator (e.g., [ RUNNING... 45% ]).
components_strategy.charts: Since charts are secondary, use Recharts with minimalist styling: no grid lines, single monochrome line for the 30-day historical trend, no complex tooltips.

interactions_and_motion.animations: Minimal and instantaneous. Fade-in on load, precise background color transitions on hover.
interactions_and_motion.accessibility: Always respect prefers-reduced-motion. High contrast on focus rings (e.g., focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white).

rules: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
